title: Core Graph Annotations
description: Annotation language for the spec graph: the x-node and x-link keywords that step schemas use to declare graph nodes and links, plus the lifecycle and scope fields shared by node items.

kindName.description: A node kind name in kebab-case, e.g. 'fr', 'criterion', 'scope-item'.

nodeRole.description: The role a node plays in the graph. 'seed' is deliberately absent: the top of the graph is declared with top_of_graph, not a role.

xNode.description: Value of the x-node keyword: declares that each item of an array (or each value of a map) is a graph node. Exactly one of id or map_keyed names the id; exactly one of role or top_of_graph gives the role.

id.description: Name of the property that holds the id on each item.

map_keyed.description: True when the container is a map and the map key is the node id.

top_of_graph.description: True only for the seed kind: the node sits at the top of the graph and has no role or contract.

contract.description: Property names that make up the node's contract. Required unless top_of_graph.

coarse.description: True when the node is a coarse obligation; the built computation that reads it arrives with a later milestone.

step.description: Step id the node belongs to. Default is the numeric prefix of the schema file name.

files.description: Relative file globs holding the nodes, e.g. 'impl_context/ms_*_plan.json'. Default is the step's spec file.

xLink.description: Value of the x-link keyword: declares that a field holds links to nodes of the named kinds. The literal '*' is meant only for the verbs replaces, removes and about.

oneOf.description: The kinds the link may target.
Any kind. Only for the verbs replaces, removes and about.

kinds.description: Target kinds: a non-empty array of kind names, or the single literal '*'.

required.description: True when every item must carry at least one value for this link.

built.description: True when the link counts toward the built computation. Default false.

same_step_kinds.description: Subset of kinds that may be held in the same step as the source.

linkVerb.description: The closed vocabulary of link field names. A field name never changes meaning between steps.

nodeId.description: A node id in either kebab-case or SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE, for fields that may hold either form.

lifecycle.description: Lifecycle state of a node item. Default active.

scope.description: Whether the item is in scope now, deferred (later), or out of scope. later and out require scope_reason.

scopeReason.description: Why the item is later or out of scope.

scopeReasonRule.description: Attach in an item's allOf: when scope is later or out, scope_reason is required.
